adr_missing_required.title: Required resource fields on every line
adr_missing_required.hint: Add service.name, service.version and deployment.environment.name in one shared processor/formatter, not at call sites.

adr_event_name.title: Event is a constant snake_case name
adr_event_name.hint: Use a fixed name like import_completed and move variable data into fields: log.info("import_completed", rows_imported=n).

adr_banned_synonym.title: Banned synonym for an OTel semconv field
adr_banned_synonym.hint: Rename the field to the semconv name given in the message.

adr_semconv_prefix.title: Semconv name written with underscores
adr_semconv_prefix.hint: Use the dotted semconv key (http_route -> http.route). In structlog pass it as **{"http.route": value}.

adr_environment_value.title: Environment value is not a documented one
adr_environment_value.hint: Set deployment.environment.name to development, staging, test or production.

adr_failure_context.title: Failure line does not say what failed
adr_failure_context.hint: On warning/error and *_failed lines log exc_info=True (gives exception.type), or error.type, or http.response.status_code.

missing_attribute.title: Unknown field
missing_attribute.hint: Use the OTel semconv name if one exists. If it is a real domain field, declare it in logwarden-fields.yaml.

deprecated.title: Deprecated semconv field
deprecated.hint: Rename to the replacement named in the message.

type_mismatch.title: Field has the wrong type
type_mismatch.hint: Log the type the registry declares (e.g. http.response.status_code is an int, not a string).
